results.note: Puebla is a city with no general admission. No official page states a single standard adult entry price. Only attraction-specific or tour prices turned up.
Taxco is a town with no general admission price stated on an official page. Only individual attractions charge, such as the Museo Spratling at 75 MXN on INAH.
The official CDMX tourism page and Time Out don't state an admission price or say it's free.
Only a travel blog (Travel by Mexico) lists it as free. I found no official or ticketing page confirming that.
